name: RICHLAND COUNTY REGIONAL SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT AUTHORITY

items.verbatim: This submittal is for the removal of the existing dry chemical fire suppression system in this facility. All appurtenances and devices shall be removed and disposed of in accordance with NFPA 17. Per Marc, this is to be a $165.00 fee for code compliance. / RICHLAND COUNTY REGIONAL SOLID WASTE MANAGE
